full_prompt_en: A wide nineteenth-century harbor scene in oil on canvas, seen from a stony rise above the water. A loose gathering of townspeople fills the lower foreground, mostly viewed from behind as they look toward the activity below. Their dark coats and muted dresses form varied silhouettes with small accents of faded red and ochre; together they provide human scale for the broad harbor rather than individually posed portraits. A tall sailing vessel occupies the right side with dense masts, rigging, and a dark hull reflected in blue-green water. Smaller boats cross the middle distance. Across the inlet, pale masonry buildings and clustered rooftops recede into a bright, hazy sky. The scene unfolds in layered bands: rough earth and figures near the viewer, luminous water at the center, crowded vessels and waterfront beyond, and soft architecture merging with the atmosphere. The nineteenth-century realist and Romantic oil-painting manner combines convincing observation of the public scene but painterly simplification at a distance. Small broken strokes articulate the crowd and rigging, broader scumbled passages describe stone and sky, and delicate warm highlights mark sunlit surfaces. Outlines vary, crisp around the nearest silhouettes and dissolving in the atmospheric distance. The palette is weathered earth brown, charcoal, muted rust, faded cream, and cool turquoise water. Lighting is bright yet softened by marine haze, giving the scene both daily-life immediacy and a sense of grandeur. Natural visual complexity remains, with distant figures merging into suggestive marks. No modern ships, engines, signage, or legible text.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅布面油画呈现宽阔的十九世纪港口场景，视点位于水面上方的石质坡地。前景下缘聚集着一群松散的市民，大多背对观者，望向下方的活动。深色外套与灰调衣裙形成各异轮廓，间或点入褪色红与赭色；他们是广阔港口的尺度参照，而非逐个摆拍的肖像。右侧是一艘高大的帆船，桅杆和索具密集，暗色船身倒映在蓝绿色水中。几条小船穿行中景。海湾对岸的浅色石建筑与密集屋顶退入明亮而朦胧的天空。画面分层组织：近处粗糙土地与人群，中央发亮的水域，远处拥挤的船只与岸线，最后是与空气融合的柔和建筑。画面具有十九世纪现实主义兼浪漫气息的油画语言，对公共生活有可信观察，又在远处作绘画性的概括。细碎笔触交代人群和索具，较宽擦笔塑造石地与天空，日照表面带细腻暖色亮点。轮廓有强弱变化：近处剪影较清晰，远处逐渐融入空气。色彩是风化土褐、炭黑、低饱和锈红、褪色奶油白与偏冷的青绿色水面。光照明亮却受海上薄雾软化，使场景兼具日常现场感和宏阔感。画面具有自然的复杂性，远处人物融合于暗示性笔迹之中。没有现代船只、发动机、标识或可读文字。
style_prompt_en: Nineteenth-century realist oil painting has a Romantic atmosphere and an expansive sense of scale. Complex forms fall into clear near, middle, and far tonal layers. Firm foreground silhouettes contrast with pale atmospheric distance and economical broken brushwork. Luminous cool blue-green passages alternate with weathered earth browns, charcoal, faded cream, and restrained rusty accents. Small observed marks suggest density without separately outlining every element. Natural light touches selected edges and planes; reflections and scumbled highlights enliven quiet midtones. Transparent shadow glazes, opaque warm accents, and lightly textured strokes reveal traditional oil handling on canvas. Believable perspective and softened distance create a warm, quietly dramatic mood.
style_prompt_zh: 十九世纪现实主义油画带有浪漫主义空气感与开阔尺度。复杂形体分布于清楚的近、中、远明暗层次。近景轮廓明确，浅色空气中的远景由简练碎笔逐渐柔化。发亮冷青绿与风化土褐、炭黑、褪色奶油白及克制锈红交替。细小观察性笔迹暗示丰富密度，形体并非逐项描边。自然光落在部分边缘和平面，反射与擦出的亮笔激活安静中间调。透明阴影罩染、不透明暖色点笔与轻微纹理呈现传统布面油画手感。可信透视和柔化远景形成温暖、含蓄的戏剧感。
theme_en: A nineteenth-century crowd overlooking a busy harbor
theme_zh: 十九世纪人群眺望繁忙港口
name: Alfred Dehodencq
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
